name: macinwind-web
description: MAC in WIND – web workspace (backend + frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
